opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland
opportunities.title: Undergraduate Tuition Fee Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Low‑income households, ordinarily resident in Scotland (or substantial connection), not eligible for other tuition fee support, UK indefinite leave or asylum seeker, not already graduated unless applying for a second undergraduate degree under specific conditions, must have an unconditional offer for an undergraduate degree at a Scottish HEI for 2026‑27.
opportunities.summary: Provides top‑up tuition fee support of up to £1,820 per year for eligible undergraduate students in Scotland who lack other funding, helping them enrol in a first or second undergraduate degree.

opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland
opportunities.title: Carnegie Masters Grants

amount.raw: up to £10,000 for a 1‑year full‑time course or up to £5,000 per year for a 2‑year programme (plus optional stipend up to £5,000)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Low‑income Scottish households, ordinarily resident in Scotland, must not have previously completed a postgraduate degree, must have secured a place on a first postgraduate Masters at an eligible Scottish HEI, and be eligible for the SAAS postgraduate tuition loan.
opportunities.summary: Top‑up tuition fee support for eligible students undertaking their first postgraduate Masters in Scotland, aiming to increase participation of low‑income students in postgraduate study.
